summary: This RFC requires Expert Review for additions to the part of the IANA XML Namespace and Schema registries that holds IODEF extensions. It was replaced by RFC 7970.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 6685 adds an expert review step for a defined group of IODEF XML schema registrations. The review checks that the extension is appropriate for IODEF.

subtitle: Requires expert review for IODEF XML schema registrations.

tldr.problem: IODEF extension registrations needed review for compatibility with IODEF and existing extensions in addition to IANA schema review.
tldr.mechanism: Changes to XML Schema registry entries beginning with urn:ietf:params:xml:schema:iodef are subject to IODEF Expert Review.
tldr.outcome: RFC 6685 is a Standards Track document and was obsoleted by RFC 7970.

today: RFC 6685 was obsoleted by RFC 7970, according to the unit metadata.

sections.title: IODEF Extension Registrations
sections.content: IODEF extensions can add class data through AdditionalData and RecordItem elements. These extensions generally register their namespaces and schemas with the IANA XML Namespace and XML Schema registries. RFC 6685 adds an IODEF expert review to check whether the extension contents are compatible with IODEF and other IODEF extensions.
sections.plainLanguage: IODEF extensions can add new structured information. This RFC requires an IODEF expert to review certain schema registrations as well as the existing IANA schema review.

sections.title: When Expert Review Applies
sections.content: Changes to the XML Schema registry for schema names beginning with urn:ietf:params:xml:schema:iodef are subject to IODEF Expert Review. The IETF Security Area Directors designate the expert or experts who conduct these reviews.
sections.plainLanguage: The additional review applies to schema names with the specified IODEF prefix. The IETF Security Area Directors choose the reviewing experts.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC states that it has no security considerations. Its main change is a review requirement for a subset of XML Schema registry entries.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC says it has no security considerations. It defines an administrative review procedure.
